scope: P1-A69 complete classic Guan Ping, Longyin runtime, AI, WPF presentation and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网当前经典关平（蜀4体力，龙吟）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结当前经典关平与龙吟文本，并提供经典静态大图入口。
官方历史攻略用于交叉核对蜀势力、4体力，以及弃一张牌、杀不计次数和红色杀摸牌的完整结算。
三国杀OL官方当前武将页用于交叉核对龙吟的现行规则文本。

ruleText.longyin: 每当一名角色于其出牌阶段内使用〖杀〗时，你可以弃置一张牌，令此〖杀〗不计入限制的使用次数，然后若此〖杀〗为红色，你摸一张牌。

implementation.triggerWindow: after a current-turn actor declares an ordinary, fire or thunder Slash during Play and before the first target response; a multi-target Slash opens this window once
implementation.costCandidates: one exact card from the Longyin owner's hand or equipment zone, plus an explicit skip choice; private candidates are never projected to unrelated seats
implementation.slashCountPolicy: the first successful Longyin removes the count only when that Slash originally consumed the ordinary Play-phase limit; additional owners may still use Longyin but cannot remove it twice
implementation.redPolicy: a Slash is red only when it has at least one physical card and every physical card is Heart or Diamond; black, mixed-color and cardless virtual Slashes do not draw
implementation.aiPolicy: uses only the owner's private exact costs plus public relationship to the Slash source, prefers cheap costs for self or allies, values a red replacement draw and avoids hostile or redundant payments

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: accepted commands reconstruct the declared Slash frame, stable owner order, exact private cost, one-time count rollback, optional red draw and first target continuation under rules v101
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: package 1.96.0 retains the complete Man Chong roster without Guan Ping or Longyin; package signature and content hash provide the new-content boundary

portrait.attribution: Official classic Guan Ping artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

acceptance.visualReview: 227 and 228 at 1120x740 inspected: official Guan Ping card art and the exact-card Longyin prompt are readable without clipping, overlap or horizontal overflow
assertions: package 1.97.0 publishes complete Guan Ping while package 1.96.0 retains its prior Man Chong boundary
Longyin opens before the first Slash target response and exposes only the owner's exact hand and equipment costs
Longyin owners receive the same private window when another current actor uses Slash during Play
a successful first Longyin removes one counted Slash use while a skipped later window preserves the ordinary limit
red Slash use draws exactly one card after paying the cost while black Slash use draws none
the paused private Longyin choice replays with identical player state and public events
WPF exposes Trigger metadata, official art, exact private choices, player guidance, event stack and battle cue
incompatible old-rules WPF saves are rejected without replacing the active game or rewriting the original file

deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
physical multiplayer host and remote-client acceptance
